Vera,
Adding to the welcome - we are very excited that you're on board!
Since the next CPS digital huddle is a ways off, it would be great for CPS technical/policy folks and interested bureau
leadership to meet with you beforehand. We would love to hear about your plans for the portfolio and give you an
overview of CPS' work in these arenas. If that sounds good, we can find a time in the next couple of weeks.
Best,
Leah

relationships.evidence:
[opaque block] Google Vault- Fwd: New Senior Advisor for Technology and Democray
In addition to the welcome from broader CPS, I wanted to introduce you to the crew working on Disinformation in the
Office of Civilian Military Cooperation (CMC). We run the USAID relationship with DOD and our folks in DC, the
Pentagon, and at each of the COCOMs are working on USAID and DOD interests in this disinformation/technology/
security/governance space every day. We would love to connect with you on what opportunities we are pursuing and
some of the challenges we're grappling with. So you know on this email - we have:
[opaque block]
[opaque block]
• [opaque block]
[opaque block]
[opaque block]
[opaque block]
[opaque block]
[opaque block]
[opaque block]
[opaque block]
[opaque block]
Each of theseteam members are working on these issues every day -and supporting the USAID teams at the
combatant commands who are focused on civ-mil efforts in the field. Our EUCOM team in particular right now is
highly focused on this set of issues as they engage in planning for next steps in Eastern Europe.
We would love to connect as you make your rounds and support your work on this important issue!
best,
Ciara (CMC Director)
